description: Vote yes/no/maybe on a proposed time. The token decides who is voting: an owner_token votes as the organizer, a share_token as that participant.

time_option_id.description: Time option ID to vote on (from get_event / get_summary)

token.description: The token from a personal link (the last part of /e/{token}). May be either an organizer owner_token or a participant share_token; the server works out which.

name: vote_time_option
